text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx errors for /v1/generate across us-west-2 (error-rate > 7% over 2m). Paging sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): I’m on it. quick summary? what’s impacted (hosted/dedicated/private)?

maria: Hosted API primarily. Some Dedicated customers show elevated tail latency but not full errors. 5xxs concentrated on model-route `redwood/gpt-13b-quant` (traffic shard A).

jamal: Observed surge ~10:12 UTC after a config push — last deploy in-prod was at 10:09 UTC (deploy-bot).

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: commit abc1234 -> prod @ 2026-03-15T10:09:14Z. Changeset: continuous-batching tweak + kernel selection tuning.

sam (oncall): Ok hypothesis 1 = deploy change (batching/kernel) caused regressions (timeout/eviction) on this model path. Hypothesis 2 = autoscaler churn causing worker evictions + cold KV cache. We’ll triage both.

elaine: Customer-impact quick look: ~8% of total requests failing for the route. Top 10 API keys show 70% of failures but still spread. CS already alerted 3 enterprise customers.

leo (sre): Share relevant logs and a minimal grep:
```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep -i "evict\|error\|timeout" -n
1023: 2026-03-15T10:09:25Z ERROR worker-12: eviction failed: pinned KV in use
1041: 2026-03-15T10:10:02Z WARN kernel-selector: selected fallback kernel for op attention_softmax
1102: 2026-03-15T10:11:07Z ERROR request-uv: request timeout after 30s, connid=0x7f9a
```

sam (oncall): Good. jamal, can you confirm autoscaler activity around 10:08-10:12?

jamal: Yes — I see spike in scale-down events right at 10:09:10 then immediate scale-ups 10:10-10:11. Looks like a thrash loop: one worker removed, then new ones provisioned.

maria: We also rolled a batching config via config service at 10:08:57 (cfg id cfg-20260315-14). That config increases max batch size to 1024 and reduced task timeouts for batching flush.

sam (oncall): Proposed mitigation plan (live):
- Step A (quick): route traffic for `redwood/gpt-13b-quant` -> fallback variant `gpt-13b-quant-stable` (retains older kernel path). Owner: sam.
- Step B (test): revert config `cfg-20260315-14` in prod (no full rollback) and apply to a single canary shard. Owner: maria.
- Step C: disable autoscaler aggressive scale-down policy for 5m to avoid thrash. Owner: jamal.
- Step D: if still failing, plan full rollback of commit abc1234. Owner: elaine (coordinate with deploy).

sam (oncall): I’ll do Step A now. Performing routing change to fallback variant for shard A.

sam (oncall): DONE — routing updated. Monitoring metrics: error-rate dropped from 7.8% -> 4.1% in first 60s. Latency tail also improving.

elaine: Noted customer updates: emailed affected customers with mitigation status and ETA for next update.

maria: I’m starting the revert test on a single canary (shard C). Commands: 
```bash
# revert batching config on canary
curl -X POST "$CONFIG_SVC/api/v1/configs/apply" -d '{"shard":"C","cfg":"cfg-20260315-14","action":"revert"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Expected outcome: error-rate on canary falls to <1% within 2m.

leo (sre): Parallel log check: kernel-selector warnings correlate with load spikes. If revert reduces kernel fallbacks, that points to kernel-selection regression. That will be our signal.

jamal: I’ve disabled aggressive scale-down policy for the affected pool for 10m. That’s live. Watch for reduced worker churn.

sam (oncall): Timeline so far (please add any events you observed):
- 10:09:14Z deploy commit abc1234 (deploy-bot)
- 10:08:57Z config push cfg-20260315-14 (maria)  <-- config applied slightly before deploy
- 10:09:25Z first eviction error (leo logs)
- 10:10:00-10:11:30Z autoscaler thrash (jamal)
- 10:12:05Z routing to fallback variant (sam)

maria: Canary revert finished. Canary metrics: error-rate -> 0.6% within 90s. Kernel-selector warnings on canary dropped by 85%.

sam (oncall): That strongly indicates the batching/kernel config change is primary cause. We should run a controlled revert in prod for the config (not full code revert) while keeping autoscaler relaxed.

elaine: Agreed. I’ll coordinate the config revert in prod and schedule a 10-min maintenance window announcement.

sam (oncall): Product/dev note: Keep commit abc1234 in place for now (we only revert config). If config revert does not stabilize, escalate to full rollback.

jamal: Monitoring after prod revert: worker churn stopped, no new eviction errors.

leo (sre): Post-mitigation logs (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T10:15:22Z INFO kernel-selector: kernel selection stable for op attention_softmax
2026-03-15T10:15:55Z INFO runtime: request success connid=0x7f9a latency=210ms
```

sam (oncall): Running through experiment checklist for RCA/next steps:
- Confirm root cause: config `cfg-20260315-14` interacts poorly with new kernel selector heuristics -> cause: increased fallback kernels + eviction pressure. Owner: leo + maria.
- Action A: revert config in prod and mark config as unsafe. Owner: maria. Done.
- Action B: Add gating to config service so batching/kernel toggles require canary success metric. Owner: eng-platform (jamal to coordinate).
- Action C: Add telemetry for kernel-selector fallback counts by model-route. Owner: infra-monitoring (leo).
- Action D: Postmortem + publish RCA within 48h. Owner: sam.

maria: Prod revert complete. Metrics: error-rate back to baseline ~0.3%. Rolling monitoring for next 60m.

sam (oncall): Handoff plan: I’ll stay on until 10:45Z to ensure stability, then hand off to elaine for overnight monitoring. @elaine you ok to take next shift?

elaine: Taking handoff at 10:45Z. I’ll update the incident channel with any anomalies.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> partial resolution. Severity downgraded. Incident lead: sam. Follow-up required: RCA, gating for config.

sam (oncall): Quick note for RCA thread: keep hypothesis updates here. If you run a focused experiment (e.g., try smaller batch size, or disable specific kernel path) include exact commands, shard, and timestamps. We need reproducible steps.

jamal: Will add experiment notes — I ran a scaled load test against canary with old config and new kernel selector and saw no evictions. Will paste raw command + results in follow-up.

leo (sre): Action item: create Grafana panel for kernel fallback ratio and add alert when >1% over 5m. Filing ticket INF-1274.

sam (oncall): Thanks all. Leaving incident open for RCA artifacts. If anything regresses escalate immediately.

elaine: Copy. I’ll file the postmortem and include timeline + the canary logs + the revert test results.

sam (oncall): Closing loop here — recording final summary for customers: root cause = unsafe batching/kernel config change; mitigation = revert config + relax autoscaler; status = stable. Will post formal RCA in 48h. :white_check_mark:
